name: Chapter IV
summary: Barnil Stonepot is trying to reconstruct the thrilling finale of Hemet Nesingwary's famous manuscript. Recovering the final three sheets will restore the climactic conclusion to the wild hunting tale.

sections.title: The Grand Finale
sections.body: Barnil Stonepot considers this section the big finale of the entire hunting volume. To assemble the fourth chapter, he needs someone to track down and return pages twenty-five, twenty-six, and twenty-seven. Once these three lost sheets are gathered from across the jungle, the manuscript's exciting conclusion can finally be reassembled.

faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot asks for help collecting the scattered sheets so he can piece together the ending of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting book.

faq.q: Which pages are required to finish Chapter IV?
faq.answer: You need pages twenty-five, twenty-six, and twenty-seven of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to complete the fourth chapter.
This request follows Barnil Stonepot's initial call to gather the scattered leaves of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
